Report.title: Environmental Report
Report.description: A citizen-submitted report documenting an environmental hazard or incident.

issueId.description: Unique human-readable issue identifier formatted ENV-YYYY-XXXXX.

reporterName.description: Full name of the reporting citizen.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone number of the citizen.

description.description: Detailed description of the observed environmental damage or issue.

imageUrl.description: Public URL or reference to the uploaded evidence photograph.

latitude.description: Geographical latitude of the incident site.

longitude.description: Geographical longitude of the incident site.

locationText.description: Physical address or landmark description of the site.

isEmergency.description: Flag indicating if the issue is an immediate emergency.

severity.description: Current severity level assigned to the issue (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL).

aiSuggestedSeverity.description: Severity suggested by Gemini AI image and text analysis.

adminNotes.description: Action log and internal notes entered by the environmental institute authority.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the report was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the report was last modified.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Collection of all public environmental incident reports.
